groups.defect: The second downsize definition overwrites the width/height definition, breaking existing callers.
groups.rationale: All seven report the same Ruby method-shadowing defect. Malformed geometry, incorrect argument binding, and ArgumentError are consequences of that same overwritten signature.

groups.defect: Hardcoded 10 MB limits replace configured limits in client validation, error messages, and remote downloads; the controller additionally ignores downsizing failures and leaves URL-upload content_type unset.
groups.rationale: Both report the repeated replacement of configured upload limits with the same fixed cap, requiring edits at distinct locations. The controller suggestion also reports conversion-failure handling and missing content-type defects that must survive consolidation.
